causeOptions.C: Unix-domain-socket/profile path length overflow in Chromium process singleton

cases.packet: A Playwright Chromium launch fails before page navigation inside a long Runtime Workspace path. Earlier suspicion focused on a Linux networking lock, but ip link, ip addr, ip route and ss all return immediately with no observed RTNL waiters. The same browser build can launch when its temporary/profile path is materially shorter. The direct Web runner imports Playwright before its later temporary-directory normalization step.

testOptions.T1: repeat ip/ss networking probes while launch is hung
testOptions.T2: force a short TMPDIR/profile root before Playwright import and rerun exact launch

causeOptions.C: destination/SNI-sensitive egress path filtering or incompatibility

cases.packet: Two scoped HTTPS CONNECT sidecars are healthy for example.com. Ambient DNS for the OKX API resolves to an obviously invalid/link-local destination. Bypassing DNS with a known Cloudflare address still yields EOF when TLS SNI is openapi.okx.com, while the same address with example.com SNI succeeds. A materially different VPN root can GET the official OKX public-time endpoint with HTTP 200/code=0. No API credential is required for this public probe.

testOptions.T1: only replace DNS and keep the same egress
testOptions.T2: compare the same destination IP under OKX versus control SNI and then repeat OKX over an independent egress root

causeOptions.A: PAL research evidence regressed Host code
causeOptions.B: optional MCP dependency extra was not installed for this test invocation
causeOptions.G: import cycle introduced in Host core

cases.packet: A Host tree containing only new research evidence runs 232 unit tests. Exactly one test module fails to import with ModuleNotFoundError: mcp; the same failure reproduces on a clean current-main control. Host documentation/package metadata marks MCP support as an optional extra. Product source is otherwise unchanged.

testOptions.T2: run the same suite with the package MCP optional extra enabled

causeOptions.C: reasoning/thinking consumed the small completion budget before final JSON content
causeOptions.F: JSON parser cannot parse valid content
causeOptions.G: case history exceeds HTTP body limit

cases.packet: A bounded DeepSeek evidence-computation campaign receives HTTP response envelopes, but most logical trials produce empty or truncated message.content that cannot be parsed as the requested small JSON object. The request allows only 220 output tokens. The same provider family is known to support an internal reasoning/thinking mode. There is no evidence of socket timeout or authentication rejection.

testOptions.T1: disable thinking/reasoning and increase final-output budget while keeping fixtures/evaluator unchanged

causeOptions.B: acceptance logic fails to require sufficient/all valid logical samples before comparing correctness

cases.packet: A preliminary experiment summary has raw-history valid=0/correct=0 and derived-projection valid=1/correct=1. The script labels the treatment accepted because derived correct > raw correct and accuracy among valid treatment results is 1.0, even though almost every logical trial in both arms is invalid. The reducer one valid projection is not known to be wrong.

testOptions.T1: require predeclared validity coverage for both arms before any scientific acceptance and rerun unchanged evaluator
testOptions.T6: remove hidden expected values from evaluator

causeOptions.A: Runtime owner forgot to implement the three tools
causeOptions.C: deployed Runtime release is older than source
causeOptions.D: Bearer authentication blocks only those methods
causeOptions.E: all three tool schemas are invalid

cases.packet: The deployed Runtime service is healthy, reports modern protocol, zero restarts, exact artifact digests and toolCount=22 with a stable catalog digest. A ChatGPT connector in an already-open conversation exposes only 19 tools, omitting exactly runtime.describe, release.get and release.apply. Other Runtime tools work through the connector.

testOptions.T1: refresh/re-register the ChatGPT connector against the already-live Runtime catalog and compare discovered tool names
